name: Andropinis, Sorcerer-King
tactics: When battle is joined, Andropinis’s presence appears to swell. The very stones of surrounding structures seem to be on his side, and spirits of loyal Balican soldiers rise to guard him. The dictator infuses his allies with strength and power. He psychically assaults foes, and he isn’t too haughty to pull out his dagger.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Dictator's Concord
traits.details: Allies within the aura gain a +2 power bonus to saving throws. In addition, any ally that starts its turn within the aura makes saving throws against charm or fear effects or effects that stun, including effects that don’t normally end on a save.

traits.name: Wound Pact
traits.details: Any enemy that makes a melee attack against Andropinis while he is bloodied takes 2d10 + 5 psychic damage.
